title: SNPSU B.Tech Semester Examination (Demo)
subject: Computer Science Fundamentals
instructions: Answer all questions. Each question carries one mark.

wordings: Which data structure follows the First-In-First-Out principle?
Which data structure processes its elements in First-In-First-Out order?
Which operating system component manages hardware resources and system operations?
Which core part of an operating system controls hardware resources and operations?
Which network device forwards packets between different computer networks?
Which networking device directs data packets across separate computer networks?
Which database key uniquely identifies each record in a table?
Which type of database key provides a unique identity for every table record?
Which algorithm searches a sorted array by repeatedly dividing the search interval?
Which searching technique repeatedly halves a sorted array to locate an element?
Which OOP concept allows a class to acquire properties of another class?
Which object-oriented feature enables one class to obtain characteristics from another class?
Which computer component performs arithmetic and logical operations on data?
Which processor unit is responsible for carrying out arithmetic and logical operations?
Which software translates an entire high-level program into machine code before execution?
Which translator converts a complete high-level program to machine code prior to execution?
Which number system uses only the digits zero and one?
Which numeral system represents values using exclusively zero and one?
Which protocol is primarily used to transfer web pages over the Internet?
Which communication protocol is commonly responsible for transferring web pages online?
Which type of memory loses its stored data when electrical power is removed?
Which memory category cannot retain stored information after power is switched off?
Which software development model follows a sequential series of defined development phases?
Which development methodology progresses through predefined software phases in sequential order?
